{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-wv-class-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"622d23aa8f07449822020717facd78ceee4111a75da249d41faaf7063e148b7f","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-wv-class-e:lineage:15","source_registry_sha256":"2261abaab8e2b1aaff5b8a336e3bfcf845adaa75847f0210442061783d7f9afb","source_liveness_sha256":"9a1fb68777f5e9d5c4b27899084cc233b265410fee506dfe6554447a61ea026e"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Driver responsibilities","heading":"C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Driver responsibilities","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Driver responsibilities

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A03
Six points on the record bring only a letter of caution, whereas twelve points make the license subject to suspension [A03].
Why it matters: group point-thresholds; difficulty high; prereq sec04-F21; confusables sec04-F21, sec04-F20 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A03
The approved defensive driving class removes three points and may be used once every twelve months, while points themselves stay on the record for two years from conviction [A03].
Why it matters: group point-thresholds; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F22; confusables sec04-F20, sec04-F22 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A02
The first and second electronic-device offenses carry rising fines but zero points, and only the third and later offenses add three points to the record [A02].
Why it matters: group device-penalties; difficulty high; prereq sec04-F17; confusables sec04-F17, sec04-F37 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A01
The crash-reporting duty is triggered by injury, death or property damage over one thousand dollars, and the report is due within five days to the local police inside a municipality or otherwise to the sheriff or State Police [A01].
Why it matters: group crash-reporting; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F06; confusables sec04-F06, sec04-F07 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A01
The liability minimums pair twenty-five thousand dollars for one death or injury with fifty thousand dollars for two deaths or injuries, and the property damage minimum is also twenty-five thousand dollars [A01].
Why it matters: group insurance; difficulty high; prereq sec04-F08; confusables sec04-F08 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A04
Driving while suspended for a non-DUI reason may bring a ninety-day suspension, whereas driving while revoked for DUI brings mandatory jail of thirty days to six months plus a six-month revocation [A04].
Why it matters: group driving-while-suspended; difficulty high; prereq sec04-F31; confusables sec04-F31, sec04-F27 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A05
The speeding point tiers climb from three points for eleven to fourteen miles per hour over, to five points for fifteen to nineteen over, to six points for twenty or more over the limit [A05].
Why it matters: group point-values; difficulty high; prereq sec04-F36; confusables sec04-F35, sec04-F36 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A03
The Driver License Compact brings out-of-state convictions and points onto your record, while the Non-Resident Violator Compact lets you accept a citation and drive on but has your home state suspend you if you fail to comply [A03].
Why it matters: group compacts; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F23; confusables sec04-F23, sec04-F24 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A02
Hands-free use of an electronic device is allowed while driving, but any call, image, game or message handled on a device that is not hands-free is a violation [A02].
Why it matters: group device-rules; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F14; confusables sec04-F14, sec04-F16 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A04
Mandatory revocation triggers include three reckless driving convictions within twenty-four months and two or more moving violations as a graduated driver, so the count and the time window both matter [A04].
Why it matters: group mandatory-revocation; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F28; confusables sec04-F28, sec04-F29 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec04-R11 | anchor: A03
Failing to appear or comply with any court ticket or order, even a non-traffic one, and failing to maintain child support both lead the DMV to suspend the license [A03].
Why it matters: group court-compliance; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F25; confusables sec04-F25, sec04-F26 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-R12 | anchor: A01
A referral about an unsafe family member can lead the DMV to reexamine that driver, and refusing a required re-examination is by itself grounds for suspension or revocation [A01].
Why it matters: group fitness-to-drive; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F04; confusables sec04-F04, sec04-F05 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R13 | anchor: A05
Fleeing from an officer is the only eight-point offense on the scale, while following too closely and improper turning sit at the bottom with two points [A05].
Why it matters: group point-values; difficulty low; prereq sec04-F34; confusables sec04-F34, sec04-F39 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]
